title: The Structure of the Homunculus: I. Shape and Latitude Dependence from H2 and [Fe II] Velocity Maps of Eta Carinae

evidence.locator: Abstract: a distance of 2350 ± 50 pc and an inclination angle of 41 degrees (the polar axis is tilted 49 degrees from the plane of the sky). Sect. 2: the slit along the polar axis of the Homunculus at P.A. = 310 degrees. Sect. 4: D = 2350 ± 50 pc and i = 41.0 ± 0.5 degrees, the tilt of the polar axis out of the line of sight; the age of the Homunculus is about 160 yr. Introduction: primarily a reflection nebula at UV, visual and near-IR wavelengths.
